validation_references.note: Reported company net profit; the comparison card may use a different, undocumented earnings basis. Preserve its value and flag the discrepancy.

limitations: Collection begins with this installation; old pre-announcement snapshots are not reconstructed.
Moneycontrol estimate-asof and original release timestamps are not supplied by these feeds.
Values have source display precision; source percentages can differ from recomputation.
Upcoming high/low tabs mean estimated year-over-year profit growth, not high/low analyst forecasts.
The reference is current index membership; it cannot classify historical membership.
Tracking every constituent does not mean analyst estimates are available for every constituent.
